english.title: Intentionally interfere with any building constructed / works done on land in compliance with an enforcement order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally interfered with

(A)_[a building, namely **(..SPECIFY BUILDING..), constructed on]_
(B)_[works executed on]_
(C)_[**(..SPECIFY THING..), installed on]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY THING..), installed under]_
(E)_[**(..SPECIFY THING..), installed over]_
(F)_[**(..SPECIFY THING..), installed across]_

land at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) in compliance with an enforcement notice under section 29 of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990
english.legislation: Contrary to section 31(3) of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
intentionally interfered
with building constructed / works executed on land in compliance with s29 enforcement notice OR
with anything installed on / under / over / across land in compliance with such notice

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
